nodes.label: Butcher on Couch — Mascot Character
nodes.description: A man with dark messy hair and a short beard, wearing a dark jacket over a patterned shirt and dark jeans, sitting relaxed on a brown leather couch. He holds a TV remote control in his right hand and leans back with one arm resting along the back of the couch. His expression is a confident, relaxed smirk. The background is solid black. The pose and style resemble the character 'Butcher' from a TV show.

nodes.label: Relaxed Seated Pose with Remote
nodes.description: Character is seated in a casual, leaned-back posture on a leather couch, right arm extended forward holding a remote control, left arm draped over the couch back. Legs crossed or casually angled. Conveys ease and confidence.

nodes.label: Leather Couch with Black Background
nodes.description: Setting is a brown leather couch in a studio-style environment with a solid black background. The lighting is dramatic, focused on the subject, suggesting a professional or stylized promotional photo shoot.

nodes.label: Confident and Relaxed Emotion
nodes.description: The character's facial expression is a slight smirk conveying confidence, amusement, or self-assurance. Overall emotional tone is casual, comfortable, and slightly cocky — consistent with a 'chilling and in control' vibe.

nodes.label: TV Remote Control Prop
nodes.description: A standard black TV remote control held in the character's right hand, pointed slightly forward. Symbolizes leisure, watching TV, or being in control of the channel/content.
